description_en: Describes the syntax and examples of the SegmentHDSky operation in the image segmentation (imageseg) category
description_zh: 本文介绍分割抠图（imageseg）类目下的天空高清分割SegmentHDSky的语法及示例
name: SegmentHDSky

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image in which you want to segment the sky. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored on your on-premises machine or in an OSS bucket in a region other than China (Shanghai), see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 需要分割天空的目标图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: image_url

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the segmented image.
After matting, a four-channel PNG image is returned. The image is uncompressed, and its dimensions remain unchanged, but the file size increases.
The URL is a temporary URL and is valid for 30 minutes. After it expires, the URL becomes inaccessible. To retain the file for a long time or permanently, access the URL and download the file to your OSS bucket or other storage space within 30 minutes
ImageURL.description_zh:
分割后的图像URL地址。
抠图之后返回四通道PNG图，无压缩，图像尺寸保持不变，图像体积会变大。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
